name: syntha
description: Generate realistic, fully synthetic patient cohorts (CSV or FHIR R4) trained on de-identified retrospective EHR episodes. Locale-aware (Turkish primary care), 9 Synthea-style clinical modules, polyserial/tetrachoric Gaussian copula, dual-coded LOINC + SNOMED CT + ICD-10 + RxNorm.
long_description: syntha lets you generate synthetic patient records (no real-patient row is ever returned) for ML training, healthy-control cohorts in case–control studies, FHIR pipeline / ETL integration testing, biostatistics teaching, and data augmentation — without redistributing any source data. The connector exposes 8 tools: list and inspect the bundled cohorts (tolerant 135,569 episodes; strict 55,141), generate a CSV cohort, generate a FHIR R4 transaction-Bundle NDJSON, run AST-validated rejection sampling against a pandas-style filter expression, and enumerate the clinical modules and physiologic-validity rejection rules the generator applies. Built on the open-source syntha-ehr library; Apache 2.0; full source at https://github.com/ArioMoniri/syntha.

tools.name: syntha_version
tools.description: Return the syntha library version and bundled-cohort fingerprints.

tools.name: list_bundled_cohorts
tools.description: List the cohorts whose trained copulas ship with this connector (tolerant, strict).

tools.name: get_cohort_summary
tools.description: Show n_train, comorbidity prevalences, lab/vital columns, and source date window for a cohort.

tools.name: generate_cohort_csv
tools.description: Generate N synthetic patient records as a CSV string (physiologic constraints applied by default).

tools.name: generate_cohort_fhir
tools.description: Generate N synthetic patients as FHIR R4 transaction-Bundle NDJSON, with 9 Synthea-style modules.

tools.name: sample_conditional
tools.description: AST-validated rejection sampling — return only synthetic records matching a pandas-style filter expression (e.g. 'Hipertansiyon == 1 & age > 60').

tools.name: list_clinical_modules
tools.description: Enumerate the 9 Synthea-style modules and the source flag each fires on.

tools.name: list_physiologic_constraints
tools.description: Enumerate the physiologic-validity rejection rules (pulse pressure, Friedewald, eGFR ↔ creatinine).
